nodes.title: Policy improvement step

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Markov decision process with a finite set of states $S$, real rewards and stochastic transition probabilities, and let $0 \le \gamma < 1$. Let $\pi$ be a deterministic policy, with Bellman operator $T^\pi$ and value $V^\pi$. If $V : S \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $V(s) \le (T^\pi V)(s)$ for every state $s$, then $V(s) \le V^\pi(s)$ for every state $s$.

Policy iteration run for $n$ steps from a deterministic policy $\pi : S \to A$ is the policy obtained from $\pi$ by applying the policy improvement step $n$ times.

If $V^\pi \ne V^*$, then the improved policy $\pi'$ satisfies $V^{\pi'} \ne V^\pi$ (as functions on $S$).
nodes.title: Away from optimality, improvement changes the value

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Markov decision process with a finite set of states $S$, a finite nonempty set of actions $A$, real rewards and stochastic transition probabilities, and let $0 \le \gamma < 1$. Write $V^\pi$ for the value of a deterministic policy $\pi : S \to A$. For every deterministic policy $\pi$, the improved policy $\pi'$, which is greedy for $V^\pi$, satisfies $V^\pi(s) \le V^{\pi'}(s)$ for every state $s$.

If $i \le j$, then $V^{\pi_i}(s) \le V^{\pi_j}(s)$ for every state $s$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
